name: lease-schedule
title: Lease liability and right-of-use schedule
for_each: select l.id, l.reference || ' ' || l.description as name from leases l where exists (select 1 from schedule_current s where s.lease_id = l.id)

sections.title: Lease
sections.sql: select l.reference as lease, e.name as entity, o.name as lessor, l.description, l.address, l.commencement_on, l.term_end_on as lease_term_ends, l.payment_frequency as payments, l.payment_timing as paid_in from leases l join entities e on e.id = l.entity_id left join lessors o on o.id = l.lessor_id where l.id = $1

sections.title: Measurements
sections.note: Each one prepared by one person and approved by another.
sections.sql: select reason, effective_on, discount_rate_pct as rate_pct, liability, rou_carrying as right_of_use, liability_change, gain_loss, prepared_by, approved_by from measurements where lease_id = $1 and approved_by is not null order by period_no, approved_at

sections.title: Schedule
sections.sql: select period_on as period, paid_on, opening, payment, interest, closing, depreciation, rou_closing as right_of_use from schedule_current where lease_id = $1 order by period_no

name: month-end-journal
title: Month-end lease journal
for_each: select e.id, e.code || ' ' || to_char(date_trunc('month', current_date) - interval '1 month', 'YYYY-MM') as name from entities e

sections.title: Journal by account
sections.note: Last month. Debit positive, credit negative. Key it into the ledger as one journal.
sections.sql: select account_code, account_name, round(sum(amount), 2) as amount from journal_lines where entity_id = $1 and month = (date_trunc('month', current_date) - interval '1 month')::date group by account_code, account_name having round(sum(amount), 2) <> 0 order by account_code

sections.title: By lease
sections.sql: select reference as lease, source, account_name, round(sum(amount), 2) as amount from journal_lines where entity_id = $1 and month = (date_trunc('month', current_date) - interval '1 month')::date group by reference, source, account_name order by reference, source, account_name

name: critical-dates-report
title: Critical dates report
for_each: select e.id, e.code || ' ' || e.name as name from entities e

sections.title: Missed and the next 12 months
sections.sql: select reference as lease, description, event, due_on, due_on - current_date as days, detail, owner from critical_dates where entity = (select code from entities where id = $1) and due_on <= current_date + 365 and (due_on >= current_date or event in ('option: last day to exercise','rent review','bank guarantee expires')) order by due_on

sections.title: Rule breaches
sections.sql: select rule, record as lease, finding from compliance_findings where entity = (select code from entities where id = $1) order by severity, rule
